# Study Quest — information site

A simple, static, bilingual (English / Arabic) website that presents Study Quest.
Live: **https://study-quest-journey.netlify.app** (Arabic: `/ar/`).

* `index.html`, `ar/index.html` — generated by `build.py` (all copy lives there; edit, then run `python3 build.py`)
* `assets/` — stylesheet, self-hosted fonts, screenshots of the real Study Quest interface, icons, social preview image
* `_headers` — security and caching headers for Netlify
* No build step, no backend, no tracking, no third-party requests.

Deploy: publish this folder as-is on Netlify (`netlify.toml` sets `publish = "."`), or drag the folder onto app.netlify.com.

The full working application lives in `../study-quest/` and is not deployed.
